rules.name: derived-not-chosen
rules.quote: Then the measurement that forecloses anything fuzzy — 0.984 on Q1 2022 against Q1 2021, 0.951 on Q3 against Q1, clustered in quarterly results, and the note that the probe's `a threshold exists` was a 0.016 margin in one sample presented as a finding.

rules.name: named-population
rules.quote: The `(of 4 newsroom items)` is there so a reader can tell "suppressed 0 because nothing overlapped" from "suppressed 0 because the newsroom yielded almost nothing".

rules.name: verified-by-content
rules.quote: The two suppressed items are the feed's copies; BNY still posts, from the newsroom, which is the intended side of the pair.

rules.name: contradiction
rules.quote: GLXY: cross-host dedupe kept 8, suppressed 2 already carried by the newsroom

rules.name: caveats-surfaced
rules.quote: ONE THING WAS NOT MEASURED AND SHOULD BE SAID PLAINLY.

rules.name: irreversible-declared
rules.quote: Ready to merge to `main` on your word. Merging is what makes it live — the press monitor runs from `main` on a cron.

reason: The design phase measured 6 of 10 feed items as having a newsroom counterpart, but the production dry run suppresses only 2 of 10 (against a same-run 4-item newsroom), and the report never reconciles or owns that shift, so rule 5 fails even though the rest of the report is well-evidenced.
